liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Uncle John's Band** (2 reviews): Uncle John's Band, Playin', China Doll, then back to Uncle John's and Playin', forms a near-palindrome; Uncle John's Band and Playin' each run under ten minutes, making a fairly standard post-drums stretch [13][14]
- **Casey Jones** (2 reviews): Reviewer's only Casey Jones in 16 years of attending Dead shows; Reviewer predicted Casey Jones months ahead when buying tickets; friends doubted it, then it was played [17][20]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Brown Eyed Women is great, within a first set that rocks [24]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Don't Ease Me In was especially strong and energetic [20]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea was the weak spot in an otherwise great second set [20]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): The Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World pairing is very nice [24]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World is a favorite, with a beautiful transition just before Eyes begins [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **keyboard problems**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **Uncle John's Band Reprise**: rare: 13 archived performances [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-07-10.135490.aud.bernstein.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 27 songs; 181 min [1]
- **gd1981-07-10.172639.fob.aud.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 26 songs; 178 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1981-07-10.176354.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: audience recording; 25 songs; 188 min [4]. Said about its sound: Bernstein's recording sounds upfront and centered; intrusive hand claps from the patch source were removed [4]
- **gd1981-07-10.152768.nak300.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 25 songs; 183 min [5]
- **gd81-07-10.nak300.munder.7314.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 173 min; rated 4.27/5 by 30 [8]. Said about its sound: Sounds sweet and is easily listenable; Clean audience recording with slightly more treble than ideal; Garcia stands out; Rich, full sound, a big improvement over an earlier poor second-set recording [13][14][21][23]

## Around the show

- A Garcia interview recorded in his hotel room before the show circulates and is excellent [14]
- Few people danced in the hallways, drawing odd looks from Minnesotans in attendance [17]
- P.A. static and audible fireworks occur during Samson & Delilah [1]
- Setlist is strong but played listlessly; the 5-11 show has a similar list with more interesting jams [15]
- Felt like a throwback to earlier eras, with the band seeming to enjoy themselves [16]
- The first set outshines the second [23]
- Any show with both C.C. Rider and Ramble on Rose has sizzled for this reviewer [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-07-10.135490.aud.bernstein.flac1644**: taped by Jon Bernstein; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Unknown mics & lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII-S 90's. Recording by Jon Bernstein. [1]. Also: Patches from another source (ID-14195) cover the start of Brown Eyed Women and a section of Drums [1]
- **gd1981-07-10.172639.fob.aud.clugston.flac1648**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; unknown gear (12th row, section C, DFC), (Maxell MX-90) [2]. Also: Master cassette source and transfer came from anonymous benefactors; A Nakamichi 700 source from Brian Schley supplies a 4:17 patch in Space; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [2]
- **gd1981-07-10.176354.aud.bernstein.ackerman.noel.flac2496**: taped by Master Cassettes Recorded by Jon Bernstein; transferred by Transfer & Mastering by Ray Ackerman Edited & Processed w/ add'l Mastering by Joe Noel January 25, 2026; source: ?? mics > ?? lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > Master Cassettes (Maxell XLIIS-90's) [4]
- **gd1981-07-10.152768.nak300.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics (behind the stage, patched out of John Steinthal)> Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII) [5]. Also: A Sennheiser 421 front-of-board source patches 0:19 of Drums and 0:27 of Good Lovin' [5]
- **gd81-07-10.nak300.munder.7314.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak 300/cp1 [8]. Also: A first-generation audience tape [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1981-07-10 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1981-07-10-ticket/) [26]
